title: Crane as the Navy's off-world reverse-engineering center
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane; Wright-Patterson AFB

tellings.quote: my contacts told me that if rright Patterson is the center of the Air Force's most exotic off-world reverse engineer engineering efforts Naval surface Warfare crane is the center of the Navy's off-world reverse engineering efforts

plain: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research site, is said to be the center of the Navy's work on off-world technology. That work would be reverse engineering: taking craft that did not come from Earth apart to learn how they work. Michels tells this himself, passing on what unnamed contacts told him: just as Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base, is the center of the Air Force's "most exotic off-world reverse engineering efforts," Crane is the center of the Navy's. If true, it would mean more than one branch of the military has its own program studying non-human craft.
